sources.fact: LBBD20/DO Ground to second floors, 6-8 Town Quay, Barking is 0.06ha with 9 minimum/maximum net dwellings.
The current record carries planning-permission-status permissioned but also Notes: Lapsed; the lapsed note is preserved.
The record reports planning-permission date 30 December 2015, permission type other and planning-history id 21870.
The record has a point and blank geometry; neither is an HMLR title polygon or exact application red-line.
Ownership status not-owned-by-a-public-authority is a category and does not identify a legal proprietor/title.
A separate DO-related Brownfield record at Ground to 2nd Floor Units 2,3,4 & 5 Town Quay Wharf carries 15 dwellings and a separate lapsed permission history; the two records are not merged.
LBBD83/HQ Town Quay Wharf is a separate current Brownfield record for 147 dwellings with full planning permission dated 15 February 2022.
The HQ 147-home record has a distinct entity/reference, capacity and planning-history id; it is not evidence that the DO 6-8 Town Quay lapsed permission became current.

Be First describes the separate Town Quay Wharf mixed-use development as 147 apartments, 62 council homes and 85 private-sale apartments; this delivery evidence belongs to HQ, not the DO 6-8 Town Quay subrecord.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
The adopted Local Plan provides policy context but does not revive a lapsed subsite permission.
Development-plan status is not a substitute for exact current decision/title evidence.

examples.result: DO 6-8 Town Quay remains a 9-home lapsed-record candidate, not a verified current 9-home consent.
The permissioned field is not treated as extant because the same record says Lapsed.
DO20 9 homes are not added to the separate DO37 15-home lapsed subrecord without exact allocation/subsite topology.
DO20 is not merged into HQ Town Quay Wharf solely because both names contain Town Quay.
HQ's 147 homes and delivery evidence remain HQ-specific.
Point/blank geometry is not converted into a DO site or title polygon.
Planning-history id 21870 is retained without guessing an unverified exact current decision outcome.
Promotion remains zero until exact current DO subsite case/title relation and overlays are verified.
